label: Autosupermarket

discovery.auth: X-Auth-Token API key for dealer/profile endpoints; listing/dealer reads open

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence low). Site publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 "Autosupermarket API" reference (API Platform) with open GET /listings and /dealers plus token-auth dealer endpoints; it looks like the site backend exposed rather than a supported partner program.

reason: The AutoSuperMarket API reference (https://api.autosupermarket.it/documentazione, rendered 2026-09-25) is a dealer-account API: every request needs the dealer's X-Auth-Token ('Anche le richieste API senza autenticazione avranno esito negativo'), and its listing resources are the dealer's own (/dealer/headquarters/:id/listings, POST/PATCH/DELETE /listings). No public search; the dealer-upload side is outside the read-only automotive vocabulary.
